label: Male Falcatus-inspired small swimmer
scope: Original stylized child-friendly scene prop inspired by inventory taxon; not a scientific reconstruction. The inventory is unchanged.
design: Teal fusiform swimmer with cream belly, large eyes, two paired fin sets, asymmetric tail and one narrow forward-curved sword spine rising from behind the head. The spine must leave a visible gap above the head; do not connect the tip to the nose. No female or colour variant is a separate asset.

budgets.mount_origin: swimming body midline at (0,0,0), not floor contact
budgets.role: supporting scene life, typical 128px; inspectable at 512px
budgets.runtime_target: repository pinned Three.js; parent independent runtime/GPU/scene QA pending

coverage: Eight geometric directions plus clay, alternate key and exact triangulated wire. Static bounded candidate for independent QA, no approval or publication.
critical_obligations: Readable independent silhouette and distinctive secondary feature
Closed volumetric editable body and thick fin components
Paired landmarks and clean attachment from reverse/top/bottom
Actual exported-GLB proof and real metrics
All claims narrowed to stylized inspired scope; scientific limits retained
